common.label: Sunny Day Flooding Project, Carolina Beach camera #1, Carolina Beach, NC
common.description:
This camera is part of a [network](https://sunnydayflooding.com/) of sensors deployed on land to understand the frequency and causes of coastal floods, particularly those that occur outside of extreme events like hurricanes. The cameras are located in flood hotspots identified by community members. Flood imagery and co-located water level measurements are used to identify flooded roadways for risk communication and to validate numerical models that can be used to test flood mitigation strategies desired by communities.

Partners:

*   North Carolina State University
*   University of North Carolina
*   Sediment, LLC

common.label: Horace Caldwell Pier, Port Aransas, TX
common.description:
This camera is located in the learning center of Horace Caldwell Pier. It is positioned to observe the surf in front and along the pier. The camera documents surf conditions to complement imagery from stereo cameras observing and measuring beach runup. The pier houses the PTAT2 NDBC station (wind, temp), a Hohonu water level sensor, and is nearby the tide station of Aransas Pass (within nearby jetties).

**Partners**

*   Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi
*   Conrad Blucher Institute, Nueces County
*   AI2ES.org NSF AI Institute
